newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela 3rd oil round attracts 259 bidders-PdVSA.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela 3rd oil round attracts 259 bidders-PdVSA.

text.p: Venezuela's third round of bidding for oil operating contracts has attracted 259 bidders for the 20 fields, state-owned oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) said.

"We're extremely happy with the level of interest shown in the round," said PdVSA president Luis Giusti in a statement. "It clearly shows that Venezuela is the number one country for investment for the world's oil industry."

PdVSA said 130 foreign firms, from 25 countries, and 129 Venezuelan companies had prequalified for the auction, due to be held at the end of May. Until then prequalified bidders will visit the areas and make technical assesments. Five of the fields are reserved exclusively for Venezuelan participation.

Production at the 20 so-called marginal fields, which will be contracted out under the profit-sharing concessions for 20 years, is seen rising in ten years to at least 300,000 barrels per day (bpd) from current levels of 66,000 bpd, PdVSA has said, with total investment estimated at around $4.6 billion over ten years.
